tips: Th2 identification within the CXCR3- CCR6- compartment. Th2: CCR4+ (CCR4 is the GATA3-driven Th2-associated chemokine receptor). Only CCR4+ is labeled — CCR4- in this parent remains unannotated because the remainder is not a defined cell type. Axis design caveat: y_marker is CD8 but parent is CD4+ CD8-, so CD8 serves as a purity sanity-check axis; the call is driven by CCR4. CCR4 is also expressed on Th17, but CCR6+ cells were already removed upstream by the non_17_22_1 parent, so CCR4+ here specifically marks Th2. CRTH2/CD294 and GATA3 absent from panel.
